Desktop's compiled catalog lists zm's profiles with `doctor`, which every zm answers. `session list` came in zoom-cli 0.81.0, so the compiled entry would fail on an older zm. Desktop main takes profiles from an installed zm 0.81.0 or newer's own answer (wirecat-desktop src-tauri/src/described.rs:33), and Desktop 0.8.0 keeps `doctor`.

Deliberate: the catalog's signOut is the fallback for zm before accountRemove.remove.minVersion (0.70.0), and `session end` came in that same release, so an older zm has no sign-out to run (wirecat-desktop AccountRow.test.tsx, "an old Zoom cannot sign out"). With no sign-out, the sign-out removes nothing.

zoom-cli 0.82.0 names no meetingsProvider in its identity, so its manifest states no meetings, though it has `meetings show` and `meetings transcript`. Fix in zoom-cli.
asterisk-cli 0.10.0 names no meetingsProvider in its identity, so its manifest states no meetings, though it has `meetings show` and `meetings transcript`. Fix in asterisk-cli.
attio-cli has had `account remove` since 0.3.0. Desktop main takes it from attio's own answer (wirecat-desktop #476), and Desktop 0.8.0 offers only sign-out for Attio.

Desktop now names the same seven scopes as bitrix24-cli 0.27.0 (wirecat-desktop #483, NEED-2938 A). The text still differs in Desktop's own words: Incoming webhook and Developer resources, Other, where b24 says Inbound webhook under Common use cases, Other (bitrix24-cli src/identity.ts:35), and b24's text has a semicolon. Which wording wins is the owner's open call, like the tagline lines (wirecat-desktop journal FIND-282).
amo-cli 0.4.0 also signs in through your own integration (--client-id) and with --one-click. Desktop offers only the long-lived token. More sign-in screens are the owner's call.
